$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFGF (AIP France, chart dated 2025-12-25): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty; the French of the procedures and of the points' purposes is not recorded.
name: Beaune - Challanges

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked
source.frenchExtraction: French column of the chart text, read by script and paired with the English sentences

notes: Simultaneous use of both RWY prohibited.
Unpaved RWY unusable after heavy rainfalls.
Only TWY A and helicopter path towards TLOF can be used in night conditions.
TWY C: access planes and ULM to Air Services 21 and residents only.
After TKOF follow 010° or 190° heading and join AD pattern.
Maintain heading until 1500 ft QNH.
Preferred QFU: 023° due to noise pollution.
For short-term stopover, operators of commercial flights are invited to use preferably the paved turning area located at the western end of TWY A.
Visiting aircraft are invited to park in front of the hangars above the mooring chain located on the edge of paved strip.
Training patterns limited to 2 after 2100 local time.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
AD vicinity very sensitive to noise.
ULM pattern reserved for ACFT using grass RWY 02R20L and able to follow pattern as published. based instruction.
E-mail: pcl@aeroclub-beaunois.fr MSG: PPR / REG / TYP / CDT / DOF / ETA Departure or local flight during night: without PPR, see instructions on ACB.
PCL on FREQ A/A: HN.
PCL orders shall be transmitted within a 10 NM radius from airfield.
Aerobatics at AD (NR 6491): See AIP ENR 5.5 AEM at AD (NR 8046): See AIP ENR 5.5
Utilisation simultanée des deux pistes interdite.
Piste non revêtue inutilisable après fortes pluies.
Seuls le TWY A et le cheminement hélicoptères vers la TLOF sont utilisables de nuit.
TWY C : accès avions et ULM à Air Services 21 et riverains seulement.
TKOF : après décollage, prendre le cap 010° ou 190° et rejoindre le tour de piste.
Maintenir le cap jusqu'à 1500 ft QNH.
QFU 023° préférentiel : cause nuisances environnementales.
Les exploitants d'appareils commerciaux sont invités à utiliser préférentiellement l'aire de retournement revêtue située en extrémité Ouest du TWY A pour leurs opérations d'escale de courte durée.
Les appareils visiteurs sont invités à stationner face aux hangars à l'aplomb de la chaîne d'amarrage en bordure de bande bitumée.
Entraînement limité à 2 tours de piste après 2100 heure locale.
Roulage interdit hors RWY et TWY.
Plateforme très sensible au bruit.
Circuit ULM réservé aux appareils utilisant la piste non revêtue 02R-20L et en mesure de respecter la trace au sol publiée.
PCL sur FREQ A/A : HN.
Les commandes PCL doivent être émises à l'intérieur d'un rayon de 10 NM du terrain.
Voltige sur AD (N° 6491) : Voir AIP ENR 5.5 AEM sur AD (N° 8046) : Voir AIP ENR 5.5
